prompt: Under Texas law, what steps must a driver take before making a legal right turn on a steady red light?

options.text: Come to a complete stop, check for 'No Turn on Red' signs, and yield to all
Slow to ten miles per hour and merge into traffic without stopping fully
Honk the horn twice and turn immediately before cross traffic accelerates
Wait for a flashing amber arrow before beginning any right turn maneuver
